summary: Master Humanitarian Needs Assessment and Response Planning with MIRA, JIAF, and HRP tools. 5-day intermediate course for emergency professionals.
lede: Humanitarian needs assessment and response planning turns field information into prioritized needs and practical response plans. Designed for humanitarian professionals and development practitioners, the course covers rapid assessment design using MIRA, data validation and analysis through JIAF, and translating findings into needs overviews, response plans, and resource allocations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for humanitarian professionals and development practitioners who are ready to move from basic field experience to leading complex assessment and planning cycles. It is ideal for intermediate practitioners who understand humanitarian principles but need to master the full Humanitarian Programme Cycle (HPC).
modules: Humanitarian System Architecture and Crisis Context
Humanitarian Needs Assessment Design and Execution
Data Analysis and Humanitarian Needs Overview (HNO)
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic humanitarian principles and 2+ years of field experience in emergency response. No advanced statistical software or coding skills required; standard Excel is used for data analysis exercises. Equipment: Participants must bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed to complete data analysis and planning workshops.
